keyword: when was the last time we went to the moon

verifications.claim: NASA's Apollo 17 mission was the last time humans went to the moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Apollo 17 — the final mission in the program, which was the last time humans traveled to the moon." (R3); "the last crewed mission to the Moon for an indefinite amount of time." (R4); "the last humans to visit the Moon" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Apollo 17 as the last human moon mission.

verifications.claim: NASA's Apollo 17 mission landed on December 11, 1972.

verifications.evidence: "Apollo 17 landed on the Moon in the valley of Taurus-Littrow on December 11, 1972." (R7)

verifications.claim: NASA's Apollo 17 mission returned to Earth on December 19, 1972.
